brief: Design a homepage for a Tacoma physiotherapy clinic. Help visitors meet the physical therapist and call the clinic about their first visit. An optional enquiry form should sit below the opening.
Create a homepage for a counselor. First-time clients should see the practitioner's photo and call the office for a consultation.
Build a homepage for a law firm. Put the attorney portrait and call the office first. Use a simple contact path without checkout.
Design a homepage for a dental practice. New patients should call the office to make an appointment with the named dentist. Keep the practice overview near the opening.
Revamp the homepage for a law firm. Introduce the attorney and let visitors text the office to arrange a first meeting. Use the supplied portrait.
Create a homepage for a physiotherapy clinic. Introduce the physical therapist and let new patients email the clinic to ask about a visit.
Keep the law firm website as it is. Replace only the consultation form to collect contact details, enforce valid phone numbers, and show confirmation.
Design an editorial website for a law firm journal. The main action is opening case notes. A phone number belongs in the footer.
Build a product page for a lamp for attorneys. The single product should lead. Add the lamp to the cart. Keep the support number in the footer.
Make a homepage selling a single product: a printed guide for a dentist to read at the office. Show the cover and let visitors buy a copy. List a phone number for wholesale requests in the footer.
Build a landing page for software sold to dental practice managers. Make the dashboard preview the hero and let users start a trial. A phone number for support belongs in the footer.
Build a homepage for a bike repair shop. Let people pick an appointment and review the booking summary. Include a phone number in the footer.
Make a homepage for a community radio station. Show what is now playing and let listeners listen live. Include the studio phone number for dedications.
Create a homepage for a law firm journal focused on public articles. Avoid any phone or consultation action. The main action opens the latest issue.
Build a homepage for a law firm. Make the attorney biographies easy to read on a phone. Put the practice areas in the opening.
Create a homepage for a physiotherapy clinic. Design for a phone first. Let people compare rehabilitation services.
Design a website for a dental practice. On the phone the opening should show the office hours and map.
Build a homepage for a counselor. Keep the bio on one phone screen. The main action opens the list of groups.
Give our law practice a complete website. Prioritize a phone-sized reading layout and explain the firm's practice areas.
Build a homepage for a law firm. Let a visitor find the phone number for a first appointment immediately.
Build a homepage for a law firm. Put the attorney portrait and the public phone first.
Create a homepage for a physiotherapy clinic. Invite a visitor to phone the clinic about a first visit.
Create a homepage for a dental practice. Keep the phone link beside the lead dentist's name.
Design a home page for a counselor. Help a visitor call the practice about their first session.

Revamp the whole homepage for a New Orleans personal injury law practice. Help visitors understand the cases the attorney handles, call for a free consultation, or prepare a short private call note in the browser.
Keep the law firm website. Revise only its form to collect a callback phone number and preview a confirmation.
